bmi.title: Check Your Body Mass Index
bmi.subtitle: Calculate your BMI to understand your weight category and discover whether bariatric surgery could help you achieve a healthier life.
bmi.inputMessage: Input your weight and height to calculate your BMI and receive personalised recommendations.
bmi.bmiExplanation: BMI is an important indicator of overall health. A BMI of 30 or above indicates obesity, which raises the risk of serious health conditions. Bariatric surgery is typically recommended for individuals with a BMI of 35+ or 30+ with obesity-related comorbidities.
